ou can cancel, but there's a time window. Most orders have a 4-hour review period after you place them, and you can cancel within that time by clicking the "Cancel Order" button in your order confirmation email, or by logging into your account and canceling from the Orders section.

turns.q: How do I update my contact or account details?
turns.replyTail:
I update my contact or account details?

You can update those right from your account profile. Once logged in at www.selectblinds.com, you can edit your name, phone number, email, and password, plus manage your address book to add or update shipping addresses 
.

To log in, click the person icon in the top right and enter your email. The site uses a one-time 6-digit code sent to your inbox rather than a password, so check your email for that code to get in 
.

Anything else you'd like help with?
